subject: Recap + quick fit check — inference pilot feasibility
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T15:14:00Z
Subject: Recap from today — pilot feasibility for intake inference

Hi Tom —

Thanks again for taking 30 minutes today. Quick recap so we’re aligned and so you have a short summary to share with the team: 

Notes from the call:
- Primary use case: automate triage fields on patient intake forms (free-text -> structured fields) to reduce manual review for front-desk staff.
- Target volume: ~30–50k forms/month (peak bursts in mornings).
- Success metric: 90%+ accuracy on the 7 required fields, <200ms per inference on production path.
- Data constraints: redacted PHI available in S3; customer needs a Private deployment or VPC peering for initial pilot.

Proposed next steps (mutual action plan):
1) We’ll prepare a short pilot scope doc (what we ship, metrics, timeline) — attached.
2) You share a sample of 2–3k redacted intake records + schema mapping (S3 link or secure transfer).
3) Kick off a 4-week pilot: week 0 onboarding, weeks 1–3 model tuning + eval, week 4 results and decision.

Attachments: [discovery-recap-aurora.pdf (PDF, 125KB)], [pilot-scope-MAP.xlsx (XLSX, 24KB)]

I can jump on a 15-min call to walk the team through the pilot plan if helpful: https://cal.com/olga/15min

If this is something you want to pursue, next immediate ask is the sample data and confirmation on whether Private deployment is required for the pilot. If this is deprioritized for Q2, a quick note back is totally fine — I’ll adjust our timeline.

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Tom —

Wanted to bump this in case it got buried. Quick ask: could you share either the 2–3k sample (redacted) or a one-line signal on fit?

Options that work for us this week:
- Send the sample and we’ll schedule a 15-min onboarding review (I’ll bring Ben from Solutions).
- If you’re not ready, reply with a one-line timing preference (e.g., "Q3 budget" or "not a fit").

I’ll assume silence means deprioritized and will follow up in 6 weeks, but if you prefer a different cadence let me know.

Attaching the one-pager again for quick distribution: [discovery-recap-aurora.pdf]

Thanks — really appreciate a short signal either way.

Best,
Olga
